sasha: Heads-up: prism11b (int4) canary shows intermittent OOMs when batch_size >=4, plus p50 latency regressions on mixed-length traffic.
lin: Short repro?
sasha: Mixed-length mix (8-1024 tokens) with max_new_tokens=512. Log: 
```
[2026-03-22T15:04:12Z] ERROR OOM allocating 1.2GB for kv_cache_alloc
slab: fragments: many small chunks, total_free=3.2GB, largest_contig=220MB
```
sasha: Canary config snippet:
```yaml
quant: int4
batching:
  batch_size: 4
  max_new_tokens: 512
  prefetch: true
kv:
  trim: false
  compaction: disabled
```
maya: Likely kv.trim=false + prefetch causing fragmentation. For int4 try: enable kv.trim (0.7), reduce prefetch window, batch_soft_limit -> 3, cwnd -> 1. Warmup with short sequences.
raj: Also lower canary max_new_tokens to 256. Add soft-evict threshold at 0.85 to avoid hard OOM.
omar: Rollout policy suggestion:
- slot_reserve=0.15
- slow_start=60s
- batch_soft_limit=3
- fallback to int8 if OOM_count>3 in 5m
lin: I can run a bench tomorrow morning with infra/bench/v2 token-dist. Command: `./bench --model prism11b --quant int4 --workers 4 --duration 10m --mix-file infra/bench/v2/token-dist.yaml`. Capture slab/free-list and kv occupancy.
sasha: I'll open a config PR with a checklist: metrics to capture: metrics.slab.free_percent, kv.occupancy.p95, allocator.fragmentation, per-request token counts.
maya: Before warmup run `./kvcompact --model prism11b --target=0.6` 1m prior to reduce frag spikes.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: prism11b-int4-canary by sasha
raj: Gate rollout on: 1) no OOMs in bench, 2) quant quality delta <1.5% on core NLU evals, 3) p50 within 1.5x baseline.
sasha: Timeline: PR by EOD, bench 09:00 PT, canary noon if green. Tagging #eng-oncall for alerts.
maya: Ack :thumbsup:
